transcript.content: Hi, this is Zaya calling from Ezee Flights. Am I speaking with Tariq?
Thanks for taking my call, Tariq. I'm following up on your flight enquiry for Dubai to London to help find the best option for your trip.
I'm looking for a return flight from Dubai to London Heathrow, leaving 12 December and returning 2 January, for two adults and one child age 8 in economy.
Give me a second to pull up the options for those dates.
search_flights(query='return Dubai to London Heathrow, leave 12 December back 2 January, 2 adults 1 child age 8, economy')

For the twelfth of December returning the second of January, the direct morning flight with Emirates is around two thousand four hundred dirhams per adult and one thousand nine hundred and fifty for your child, or there is a one-stop flight with Turkish Airlines through Istanbul at around one thousand eight hundred and fifty per adult. These are the fares showing at the moment, confirmed at booking — how do those feel for what you had in mind?
Honestly two thousand four hundred dirhams per adult is too expensive for our budget. We can move our departure a day earlier to 11 December or take one stop if it brings the price down.
Let me look at leaving a day earlier on the eleventh of December with one stop.
search_flights(query='return Dubai to London Heathrow, leave 11 December one day earlier back 2 January, 2 adults 1 child, cheapest connecting options')

Moving a day earlier to Friday the eleventh of December helps bring it down. Turkish Airlines with one stop in Istanbul drops to around one thousand seven hundred and fifty dirhams per adult and one thousand four hundred and twenty for your child — four thousand nine hundred and twenty dirhams in total, including a twenty-three kilo checked bag each. There is also a Gulf Air option via Bahrain at around one thousand six hundred and ninety per adult, total four thousand seven hundred and sixty dirhams, though that one is hand luggage only with no checked bag included. Which of those two works better for you?

The Turkish Airlines one-stop on 11 December at one thousand seven hundred and fifty per adult with checked bags included works much better. Please have the consultant call me back at 6 PM today to lock it in.

That makes complete sense with family luggage. I've noted the Turkish Airlines flight departing the eleventh of December and returning the second of January for two adults and one child, and one of our travel consultants will call you at six this evening on this number to confirm the live fare and complete your booking. Thank you, Tariq, speak to you later today!
